precision.embed: fp16-stored weights, fp32 compute (sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, mean pooling + L2 norm inside the graph)
precision.yesno: word-embedding table int8, other weights fp16-stored, fp32 compute (DeBERTa-v3-xsmall cross-encoder fine-tuned for yes/no)

sources.yesno: fine-tuned from cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall (Apache-2.0) on BoolQ (CC-BY-SA-3.0) + development yes/no questions
sources.gate: question-form model + log-linear gate, trained on development questions (treaty-graph data/hybrid/gate_x.json)
